warnings: Realized returns use supplied unadjusted prices, explicit FX and booked net dividends/fees. Unrecorded costs or events are absent.
UTC calendar-day closes and 365 observations/year; no market-calendar alignment or automatic price carry-forward.
XIRR includes the closing marked value; it is not a cash-only realized-profit figure.
Supplied data quality is not independently verified. This report makes no GIPS compliance claim.
Short track record: annualized time-weighted return is withheld; ratios and tails are descriptive and statistically uncertain.
Selected-period report: opening market value is treated as invested capital for XIRR, not an original deposit.

warnings: Contributions explain recorded TWR in percentage points, not security returns or risk contributions.
Local capital P&L, net dividends and fees use segment-end FX. Opening equity/cash receive FX changes; conversion principal is separate. Price/FX interaction is assigned to price.
This endpoint allocation is not transaction-time FX attribution. Supplied quotes and booked events are not independently certified.
Cash has no modeled interest; only booked events and marked FX can contribute. Standalone fees and conversion effects remain separate from equity rankings.
Closed equities remain included. Security UUIDs identify holdings; historical sector classifications are unavailable, so no sector aggregation is inferred.
Forward wealth linking allocates compounding to later increments; alternative linking conventions can assign different component results while reconciling to the same TWR.
